custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create a tracked part, part A, for this test with Min 4 and Max 10, 5 in bin location A and 0 in bin location B, so it has a positive and a second bin.
  • Add 2 of part A to a work order line from bin location B while it holds 0, so bin location B goes to -2: on its positive bin (5) part A sits between Min and Max, on the net (3) it would be below Min.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab, with part A's part number typed in the Search box.

Setup

  1. Make part A: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Fill in: Description: ZZAUTOTEST PL C425665 PART A; Part Number: ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425665-A; Category: any one; Cost: 10.00; Sell Price: 20.00; Min: 4, Max: 10; Quantity (in the bin row): 5. Click Add Bin Location, pick a second bin location in the new row and type 0 as its Quantity, and click Default on that row. Click Save.
  2. Make work order 1: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order. Pick any Customer and any Asset. Click Save. In the New Line window that opens, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425665 LINE 1 in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close.
  3. Put part A on the line: In the line's Parts row click + Add Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425665-A in Part number and pick the result that shows Inventory Qty. Type 2 in Qty *. Click Save.
